source: direct APK extraction + visual recovery + user-confirmed mapping
description: Leg-armor icon frames 0500..0509 were recovered by visually matching the real APK inventory icon atlas against the real APK property14 character-layer resources. The APK does not expose a direct icon_code -> property14 table, so this catalog records the confirmed compatibility mapping without claiming an official server-side item table.

notes: All icon pixels and all 150xx character-layer pixels used for this recovery were extracted from the uploaded APK with SHA-256 34348c4ac16108222871203c46faabc1e6e5383c455e39b871c7666505da60b5.
The APK client proves property14 -> character layer4 -> image 15000+value for nonzero values, with a special zero-value base-leg fallback.

The mapping therefore records a user-confirmed compatibility database derived from visual matching of both real APK resource families, not an official server-side item template table.
